text: ＊は　ひでんわざ　なみのりを　つかい　なみに　のりまくった！

structure.jp: ひでんわざ　なみのりを　つかい
structure.en: used the hidden move Surf and

structure.jp: なみに　のりまくった！

patterns.name: 〜し、〜 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off at the form that normally comes before ます joins on to the next action, like て but more written in style. つかい = 'used, and'.

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる added to a verb says the action is done over and over with wild energy. のりまくった = 'rode like crazy'.
